entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, have you heard of this[n]"A.I. Mask" guy?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, "AIMaask OUZI," I guess.[n]Some extreme video streamer with[n]a robot mask and a big audience.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We got a request on the Phan-Site[n]from someone who knows him in[n]real life.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: One of the streamer's friends?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Apparently they want him to stop[n]streaming himself going around[n]doing borderline illegal stuff.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: When anyone tries to talk him out[n]of it, he flips out and gets violent.[n]They say he's out of control.
We'd better stop him.
Do we have a name?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I agree.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So if we have word from one of[n]his personal contacts, does that[n]mean we know his name?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, about that. He says he's not[n]gonna post the guy's info online.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess this AIMaask OUZI guy has[n]pissed off a lot of people. If he got[n]doxxed, things could get ugly.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So we only have his title, then...[n]or screenname, or whatever.[n]How can we get more hints?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm looking at his archives now.[n]A lot of these streams seem to be[n]from Kichijoji.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If we check around in Kichijoji,[n]maybe talk to some students,[n]we might learn something.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Students, huh? So our best shot is[n]probably weekday afternoons.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But Kichijoji isn't the only place he[n]visits. It couldn't hurt to check[n]other locations too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay, then let's all look around!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We'll leave Kichijoji to you,[n][fName].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So he's doing borderline illegal stuff in[n]some goofy mask? Cramping our style,[n]AND making life hard for people...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We gotta shut this guy down, for all[n]their sakes too!
